name: @w6w-apps/opusclip
description: Turn long-form video into short, AI-clipped highlights, and publish or schedule them to connected social accounts.

w6w.longDescription:
OpusClip turns a long-form video into short, vertical, AI-curated clips: submit a video URL, choose a curation model (talking-head-tuned ClipBasic or prompt-driven ClipAnything) and it returns ready-to-post clips with captions, an optional AI-generated headline, and a brand template applied.

This app covers the OpusClip Clip API end to end — creating and sharing projects, reading back the clips a project produced, brand templates, and export links for a single clip or a whole collection — plus content-safety censor jobs, AI thumbnail generation, and a project's trimmed source-video transcript.

It also covers social distribution: list connected social accounts, generate platform-tuned captions for a clip, publish a clip immediately or schedule it for later, and cancel a pending schedule.

Health checks track OpusClip's own status page. There is no live, pre-emptive read of remaining monthly API quota — the vendor only reports the cap by refusing a request with it already hit — so that check is declared unavailable rather than guessed at.
